parameters.description: Unique ID of the order.

schema.description: Unique ID of the order.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

currency.description: Currency related to the amount of the order

customer_note.description: Note providing additional informations, written by the customer during his order process.

discount.description: Amount discounted off the order total thanks to promo code

has_invoice.description: Flag which indicates if the order has an associated invoice

invoice_num.description: Number related to the invoice of the order

items.description: List of items ordered by the end customer. Each of these items is a variant of a specific product, in other words a version of that product with specific characteristics (color, size, etc).

payment_mode.description:
Mode used to pay the order.
It'll be 'live' if the payment is processed in production
It'll be 'test' if the payment is processed in test mode

payment_type.description:
Method used to pay the order.
It can be 'paypal', 'one_click_payment', 'stripe_no_cb', 'stripe_cb_three_d_secure', 'stripe_cb', 'mercado' for online production mode
It can be 'sandbox' for test mode
It can be 'offline' for offline production mode

promo_code.description: Unique ID of the promo code used, if applicable

receipt_num.description: Number related to the receipt of the order

shipping_amount.description: Amount related to the cost of the shipping of the order

shipping_method.description: Shipping method name used for order delivery

shipping_tax_amount.description: Tax amount related to the cost of the shipping of the order

shipping_tax_rate.description: Tax rate applied to the cost of the shipping of the order

subtotal.description: Amount of the order used for taxes computations.

tax_amount.description: Tax amount related to the amount of the order

tax_rate.description: Tax rate applied to compute tax amount of the order

total.description: Total amount of the order (taxes and shipping included).

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the order last update.

user_id.description: Contains the ID of the user if the order was made by a logged user, None otherwise.

weight.description: Total weight of the ordered items (unit: kg).

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Product Unique ID.

schema.description: Product Unique ID.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

auto_similar_products.description:
Automatically generated list containing products similar to the current instance.
The list is created from all the available products of the shop, based on criterias such as tags and collections.

collections.description: List of the collections (unique IDs) to which the product belongs.

custom_similar_products.description: Manually defined list of similar products.

highlight.description: Boolean indicating if the product should be showcased in the shop products list or not.

media.description: Unique ID of the slide selected as the product thumbnail.

meta_description.description: Product SEO description (for referencing by search engines).

meta_title.description: Product SEO title (for referencing by search engines).

pdf.description: URL of the PDF file uploaded for this product.

pdf_name.description: Name of the PDF file associated with the product.

show_similar_products.description: Boolean indicating whether the "Similar products" section should be displayed in the shop for this product or not.

slides.description: Set of slides (pictures) associated with the product.

slug.description: Product slug (used in its access URL).

tags.description: Set of tags associated with the product.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the product last update.

visibility_end.description:
Datetime until which the product should be visible to the customers.
If this field is null, the product will remain visible in the shop until it gets manually hidden or removed.

visibility_start.description:
Datetime from which the product should become visible to the customers.
If this field is null, the product will directly become visible when its status is set to "PUBLISHED".

parameters.name: creationDateFrom
parameters.description: Restricts the list of returned orders to the ones created after (or on) the provided datetime. This parameter should use the following format yyyy-mm-ddThh:MM (year, month, day, 24-hour and minute) and be expressed in UTC time.

schema.description: Restricts the list of returned orders to the ones created after (or on) the provided datetime. This parameter should use the following format yyyy-mm-ddThh:MM (year, month, day, 24-hour and minute) and be expressed in UTC time.

parameters.name: creationDateTo
parameters.description: Restricts the list of returned orders to the ones created before (or on) the provided datetime. This parameter should use the following format yyyy-mm-ddThh:MM (year, month, day, 24-hour and minute) and be expressed in UTC time.

schema.description: Restricts the list of returned orders to the ones created before (or on) the provided datetime. This parameter should use the following format yyyy-mm-ddThh:MM (year, month, day, 24-hour and minute) and be expressed in UTC time.

parameters.name: deliveryDateFrom
parameters.description: Restricts the list of returned orders to the ones whose selected delivery slot lands after (or on) the provided datetime. This parameter should use the following format yyyy-mm-ddThh:MM (year, month, day, 24-hour and minute) and be expressed in UTC time. When this filter is applied, orders that do not have a selected delivery slot (shipped by transporter, for instance) will not be returned. Also, note that a delivery slot is said to land after a given datetime if its slot_start value is later than that datetime.

schema.description: Restricts the list of returned orders to the ones whose selected delivery slot lands after (or on) the provided datetime. This parameter should use the following format yyyy-mm-ddThh:MM (year, month, day, 24-hour and minute) and be expressed in UTC time. When this filter is applied, orders that do not have a selected delivery slot (shipped by transporter, for instance) will not be returned. Also, note that a delivery slot is said to land after a given datetime if its slot_start value is later than that datetime.

parameters.name: deliveryDateTo
parameters.description: Restricts the list of returned orders to the ones whose selected delivery slot lands before (or on) the provided datetime. This parameter should use the following format yyyy-mm-ddThh:MM (year, month, day, 24-hour and minute) and be expressed in UTC time. When this filter is applied, orders that do not have a selected delivery slot (shipped by transporter, for instance) will not be returned. Also, note that a delivery slot is said to land before a given datetime if its slot_end value comes before that datetime.

schema.description: Restricts the list of returned orders to the ones whose selected delivery slot lands before (or on) the provided datetime. This parameter should use the following format yyyy-mm-ddThh:MM (year, month, day, 24-hour and minute) and be expressed in UTC time. When this filter is applied, orders that do not have a selected delivery slot (shipped by transporter, for instance) will not be returned. Also, note that a delivery slot is said to land before a given datetime if its slot_end value comes before that datetime.
